fields.description: Extra node entry points listed after the online Gateways, e.g. a CDN's 443 with transport ws.

operations.summary: Replace both lists (Gateways pick them up within a minute; audited)
operations.description: Optimistic concurrency without a stored revision. If-Match must equal the ETag of the current settings (compared under the table lock); otherwise nothing is written and 409 gateway_settings_changed tells the page to reload.

params.name: If-Match
params.description: ETag returned by the GET (or the previous PUT) the form was loaded from.
